summary: Frontend-only validation of bento card refinements (Annual goal gauge + 3 KPI cards). All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: Gauge number is wrapped by dev instrumentation <span x-dynamic>, but uses display:contents so parent font-size (24px) applies correctly - no visual regression.
rv-gauge-num CSS includes '.rv-gauge-num * { font: inherit; }' which correctly guards against instrumentation.
Consider adding a subtle indicator that ring pace tick corresponds to the pace target (currently only orange tick line inside the ring, may not be obvious).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at 1920x1080: gauge '67%' at 24px + 'of goal' at 10.5px; rv-goal-pct=$11.6M, badge '8 pts behind pace', Remaining $5.7M, Pace target 75%; switching to rv-seg-us updates to $6.4M and '3 pts behind pace'. rv-tile-open (composition 'by ship month') shows Oct $1.0M / Nov $2.2M / Dec $1.9M. rv-tile-total shows Invoiced $11.6M + Open $9.1M with stacked bar. rv-tile-forecast (All) shows Forecast $17.3M and 'Above goal $0'; US shows Forecast $8.9M and 'Above goal $500.0K'. No overflow/clipping on the 4 cards (rv-goal 369x212, rv-tile-open 369x212, rv-tile-total 369x197, rv-tile-forecast 369x197 - no scrollX/scrollY). Regression selectors present: rv-seg-*, rv-range-ytd/12m/q, rv-export-btn, rv-segment-us, rv-segment-dist, rv-top-account-1..5, rv-account-row-lids expand -> rv-account-expand-lids. Zero console errors during full flow.
